study type: Pooled analysis of three cohort studies
exposure: Middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI)
Mean uterine artery pulsatility index (mUtA PI)
outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcome (perinatal mortality, emergency caesarean delivery for fetal distress, or neonatal admission)
finding: The addition of umbilical artery pulsatility index (UA PI) to estimated fetal weight (EFW) improved the prediction of adverse perinatal outcomes, but adding other Doppler ultrasound measurements did not further improve prediction.
